desc:
🔪 Welcome to Steal The MM2 Weapons!

😈 Murderers are guarding crates with godlies...
Steal them, escape alive, and build the ultimate MM2 collection! 💀

😂 - Steal Crates from Murderers and bring them back to your base without getting caught!
📦 - Open your Crates to unlock Knives or Guns (Godly, Ancient, Chroma...) !
💵 - Your weapons make Cash that you can use to upgrade your Base and Treadmill!
🏃 - Train on your Treadmill to get faster and escape even stronger Murderers!
💤 - Your weapons keep making Cash while you're offline...

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile & Tablet
